name: OW4-outer-ignored
old: const slotOf = { outer, inner: outer === CLOTH ? DRAPE : CLOTH };
new: const slotOf = { outer: DRAPE, inner: CLOTH };

name: OW4-skin-dyed
old: export const SLOT_OF_RAMP = Object.freeze({ 2: SKIN, 4: SKIN, 5: METAL, 6: CLOTH, 7: METAL, 8: CLOTH, 10: DRAPE, 12: DRAPE });
new: export const SLOT_OF_RAMP = Object.freeze({ 2: CLOTH, 4: SKIN, 5: METAL, 6: CLOTH, 7: METAL, 8: CLOTH, 10: DRAPE, 12: DRAPE });

name: OW4-belt-on-bare-skin
old: band((x, y) => Math.abs(y - waist) <= half && Math.abs(x - centreX) <= 0.17 * height, scheme.belt, garment);
new: band((x, y) => Math.abs(y - waist) <= half && Math.abs(x - centreX) <= 0.17 * height, scheme.belt);

name: OW4-hem-one-row
old: if (below(x, y + 1) || below(x, y + 2) || beside(x - 1, y) || beside(x + 1, y)) put(i, rampBlend(ramp, 0.35 + 0.65 * tone[i]));
new: if (below(x, y + 1) || beside(x - 1, y) || beside(x + 1, y)) put(i, rampBlend(ramp, 0.35 + 0.65 * tone[i]));

name: OW4-key-past-the-sheet
old: return frame < (skin.frames[record] ?? 0) ? { skin, record, frame } : null;

name: OWNAUDIT-garment-unworn
old: if (bare && scheme.garment) paintGarment(scheme.garment, torsoOf(reg, tables, width, rows, { loin: outer, view }), reg, tables, view, width, put);
new: if (false) paintGarment(scheme.garment, torsoOf(reg, tables, width, rows, { loin: outer, view }), reg, tables, view, width, put);

name: OWNAUDIT-every-sheet-bare
old: return paintClassFrame(classic, tables, CLASS_LOOKS[skin.name], { outer: OUTER_SLOT[skin.from], view: record % 5, height, bare: BARE_SHEETS.includes(skin.from) });
new: return paintClassFrame(classic, tables, CLASS_LOOKS[skin.name], { outer: OUTER_SLOT[skin.from], view: record % 5, height, bare: true });

name: OWNAUDIT-waist-misread
old: for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) if (mat[y * width + x] === loin) loinColumns.push(x);
new: for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) if (mat[y * width + x] === CLOTH) loinColumns.push(x);

name: OWNAUDIT-garments-alike
old: 'Dark Brotherhood': look({ outer: RAMP.black, inner: RAMP.black, metal: RAMP.black, sash: RAMP.red, sign: { glyph: 'hand', colour: hex('#c0281c') }, garment: { kind: 'wrap', ramp: WRAP, edge: RAMP.grey, hem: RAMP.black } }),
new: 'Dark Brotherhood': look({ outer: RAMP.black, inner: RAMP.black, metal: RAMP.black, sash: RAMP.red, sign: { glyph: 'hand', colour: hex('#c0281c') }, garment: { kind: 'harness', ramp: RAMP.leather, edge: RAMP.grey, hem: RAMP.black } }),
